She Seems Like an Iron Lady to Me! 👑 ✨

Today, while going through my gallery and revisiting some memories from my graduation, I came across a picture with someone who holds a very special place in my MSc in International Business Management journey at Kingston University, Kingston Business School in 2024. 🎓📸

And I found myself asking:

Who is she?
She is a woman who, to me, represents what happens when passion meets purpose. 🍁 

She is Dr. Dr  Winnifred Groves, Ph.D. 🌟

A woman who has shown that success isn't simply about the position you hold or the titles attached to your name, it is about the impact you leave on the people around you.

Interestingly, I wasn't even taught by her during my MSc. I had the opportunity to meet her on a few occasions, and somehow, even those brief interactions left a lasting impression on me 🌿 ✨ 

I remember visiting Dr Dr  Winnifred Groves, Ph.D office. She would greet me with that warm smile 😊 a simple gesture, but one that genuinely made me feel comfortable and welcomed.

And then there was her directness 🙏 

She had that rare ability to be straightforward while still being approachable. She didn't need to say a hundred things to make an impression. Sometimes, a conversation, a smile, or a few words were enough 🤝 

To me, she represents the idea that education is not merely about transferring knowledge; it is about inspiring people to believe that they are capable of achieving more. 📚✨

Looking back at my MSc journey, I really cherish, and request Prof Sankar Sivarajah and Kingston University, Kingston Business School to facilitate educators like Dr. Dr  Winnifred Groves, Ph.D ✨ 

So, Dr.  Dr  Winnifred Groves, Ph.D, if you ever come across this post, thank you for everything. ❤️ 🙏 
#KingstonUniversity #KingstonBusinessSchool #MScInternationalBusinessManagement #WomenInLeadership #Education #Inspiration #Leadership #WomenInEducation #Gratitude #Graduation #Memories

Happy to share that I’ve joined Mercor as a Generalist Expert! 🎉 🍾 

Excited to support Mercor with high-impact AI research projects and share my expertise.

A special thank you to my mom, Vibha Rani, for always believing in me and supporting me throughout this journey. ❤️

Looking forward to it! ✌️
